comment: TMForum SID V22.5. True XMI package nesting: Resource Domain / Resource Specification ABE / Logical Resource Specification ABE / Software Resource and Software Specifications ABE / Software Resource Specification ABE. Concrete in XMI. THIS is where software version lives in SID - decomposed into majorVersion, minorVersion, maintenanceVersion, buildNumber and otherDesignator rather than a single version string. Populating these is what makes version-precise CVE matching possible (e.g. FortiOS 7.2.4 = major 7, minor 2, maintenance 4; Junos 24.2R1-S2 = major 24, minor 2, otherDesignator R1-S2). xmi.id EAID_2EED0FEF_A6F1_4627_B213_2CA92F2A09A7.

contents.name: maintenanceVersion
contents.comment: Patch or maintenance level. XMI multiplicity 1..1.

contents.name: otherDesignator
contents.comment: Vendor-specific version designator, e.g. a Junos service release such as R1-S2. XMI multiplicity 1..1.
